# `⍎` — Execute / Lookup

`⍎Y` evaluates character code in the current lexical scope.

```bpl
⍎"2+3"             ⍝ 5
x←7 ⋄ ⍎"x+1"       ⍝ 8
```

`X⍎Y` selects `Y⊃X`, using numeric coordinates or axis keys.

```bpl
T←"aa" "bb":10 20
T⍎"bb"             ⍝ 20
10 20⍎1            ⍝ 20
```

Assignments and explicit output take effect in the current session.
